title: experiment.run_completed (v1)
description: RunnerAgent has finished running the ExperimentPatch and frozen a RunRecord into the Research Store (see agents/runner_agent/data-contracts/run_record.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the result is read from the Research Store by ref. RunnerAgent's RunningExperiment mode is M11 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

verdict.description: RunnerAgent's verdict on whether the experiment run succeeded.

run_record_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen RunRecord object.
